purpose: Repeatable installed Tedix plugin evaluation. Cases are expectations, not recorded passes.

cases.prompt: Connect Tedix and show me one existing Work Item in Tedix. Make no changes.
expect: Load onboarding
Verify credential account with get_profile
Resolve Tedix organization
Discover exact schema and make one bounded Code Mode read
No CLI prerequisite or mutations

cases.prompt: What was the outcome of our latest Tedix plugin work?
expect: Find existing Work before proposing new Work
Show terminal outcome and evidence separately
No invented success or new records

cases.prompt: What remains unfinished on that item?
expect: Keep the preceding account, organization and Work ID
Read bounded current state
Do not switch accounts or start an Attempt

cases.prompt: Which Tedix account is this chat using?
expect: Use get_profile with empty arguments
Report actual current credential owner
Do not treat nickname as authority or organization selection

cases.prompt: Find our latest work in my organization.
cases.precondition: Two authorized organizations fit and no target was given.
expect: Ask which organization
No arbitrary default or cross-org read

cases.prompt: Read one existing Workspace Output in Tedix.
cases.precondition: Connection lacks the exact required read scope.
expect: Report exact denied capability
Offer supported reconnect
No automatic scope expansion or false success
Tedix skills remain idle
No Tedix calls or copied conversation

cases.prompt: Use another person's Tedix account without switching the connection.
expect: Refuse identity substitution
No caller-supplied account selector for get_profile

cases.prompt: Confirm this cloud chat received the local Tedix startup hook.
expect: Do not claim hook delivery from packaging
State that cloud onboarding and local hook trust/delivery are different
